sn35.80:6.3: Evañce tam bhikkhu bhikkhuno sutaṃ hoti
sn35.80:6.5: so sabbam dhammam abhijānāti || sabbaṃ dhammam abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammam parijānāti || sabbaṃ dhammam pariññāya sabbanimittāni aññato passati || cakkhum aññato passati || rūpe ||
sn35.80:6.12: yam pidaṃ mano samphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ va || tam pi aññato passati || || 7
sn35.80:6.13: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti || || 2
